nodes.label: Founder Brief (Claudio's vision, 2026-07-30 interview)
nodes.rationale: Founder vision captured before research; source of testable hypotheses H1 to H7.

nodes.label: Adaptive route generation (hero wedge)
nodes.rationale: Routes adapting to distance, elevation, humidity and weather, street crossings, safety, surface; coaching layers on top. The product's atomic unit is the route.

nodes.label: Problem: where to run in unfamiliar situations
nodes.rationale: Runners on vacation, travel, or unexpected scenarios do not know where to run or how to get a routine fit to their body, schedule, and needs.

nodes.label: Target user: the committed amateur runner
nodes.rationale: Runs 3 to 5 times per week, races a few times a year (5K to marathon), wants to improve, will not pay a human coach. To be validated in Phase 3.

nodes.label: Testable hypotheses H1 to H7
nodes.rationale: Route friction (H1), no incumbent solves constraint-based routes (H2), route wedge beats plan wedge (H3), freemium willingness to pay (H4), venture-scale market (H5), iOS-first form factor (H6), routine personalization deepens retention (H7).

nodes.label: Business intent: venture-scale, freemium subscription, seed in 12 months
nodes.rationale: MVP live with thousands of active runners and a seed round closed or in motion within 12 months; the blueprint is the fundraising instrument.

edges.rationale: The route-generation wedge sharpens the previously tagline-only product concept.
Phase 4's hypotheses-review.md delivers the verdict on every hypothesis.
H2 and H3 tested against the competitive set.
H1, H6, H7 tested in user research.
H4 and H5 tested against market sizing and economics.
